1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two lanterns on a small connected roof map; broad decks, slow vertical motion, and no inherited momentum.
1.natural_language: Light every blue rooftop lantern using the icon programmer. Read the settled roof state and dispatch each leap for its transition landing. Level, up, and down set the launch arc; roof height and momentum change the landing distance. A missed landing or lighting an unmarked roof ends the shift. Roofs hold during editing and dragging; each accepted dispatch advances one fixed transition. The visible FROM/TO lift state and controller rule determine that transition; the BASE column identifies each lift centre.
